about_the_game:
Siegebound – Defend, Build, and Survive the Onslaught!

🏰 A Roguelike Tower Defense Strategy Game ⚔️

Hello! I'm a solo developer working on Siegebound, a passion project that blends strategy, tower defense, and roguelike mechanics into a unique survival experience. Every siege is a test of tactical skill, adaptability, and strategic planning.

A Unique Blend of Strategy, Roguelike & Tower Defense

  • 🏰 Base Building & Expansion – Construct walls, towers, and defenses to fortify your castle.

  • ⚔️ Tactical Combat & Unit Management – Deploy and upgrade Units and Buildings that synergize together.

  • 🎲 Roguelike Progression – Spend ressources to buy powerful upgrades permanently enhancing your army or defenses.

  • 🛠️ Resource Management – Gather ressources to expand your fortress and strengthen your army.

Can You Withstand the Sieges?

With each run, no two Castles are ever the same—adapt your strategy, test new builds, and push your limits to defend against relentless Sieges.

Add to Wishlist now and prepare for battle!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-2500K / AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 960 / AMD R9 280 (2GB VRAM)
  • Storage: 5 GB available space

short_description: Siegebound is a roguelike tower defense strategy game where you build, expand, and defend your castle against relentless sieges. Construct walls, deploy units, and upgrade your defenses while managing resources. Every run is unique—can you survive the onslaught?
